mathematical_audit.hasse_block: For n=2h, r=2s+1, E=p-r, the degree of G^E is 2p+2n<3p<p^2-1. Multiplicative orthogonality over F_(p^2)^* therefore isolates -[u^n]G^E=-a_(r,n).
mathematical_audit.transverse_block: The finite logarithm is the divided-Frobenius defect of 1+w. With F_Q=P0*L_p(z^2), Item360's actual transverse coordinate is Q0=2c_T-c_L and deg F_Q<3p<p^2-1, so the same orthogonality isolates each coefficient exactly.
mathematical_audit.rank_five_sum: The diagonal moments of the two unipotent blocks vanish because deg P0<T,L. Their extension entries sum to -2c_T and c_L, giving the displayed matrix and the two exact framed functionals -a and -Q0 without imposing either ambient block entry to vanish.
mathematical_audit.base_field_de_aliasing: For N=T,L, the only possible exponents congruent to N modulo p-1 are N and N+p-1. The zeroth and Euler moments form an invertible two-equation system with c_N=(N-1)S_(N,0)-S_(N,1).
mathematical_audit.invariant_scope: The characteristic polynomial is X^4(X+a), determinant is zero, and every trace power is (-a)^k. Thus the universal regular polynomial conjugacy-invariant ring of this single matrix forgets Q0. This does not claim blindness of arbitrary framed or finite-field class functions.
mathematical_audit.root_bound: L_p'(w)=(1-w^(p-1))/(1+w). At a repeated root, L_p'' is nonzero, so multiplicity is at most two. Since zero is simple, substitution w=z^2 yields at least p-2 distinct roots, forcing linearly growing support for literal full-order Kummerization.
mathematical_audit.capacity: The construction applies to every actual row but proves no horizontal framed nonconcentration. Algebraic encoding alone earns no mass credit and the fixed-j1 ceiling remains 1/36.
